name: Microsoft Outlook
hint: An app registration in Microsoft Entra with these application permissions, admin-consented: Mail.Read, Calendars.Read, Contacts.Read, and Mail.Send, Calendars.ReadWrite, Contacts.ReadWrite for the writes; the token address holds your directory ID.

endpoints.name: list_messages
endpoints.description: Lists the messages in a user’s mailbox, Deleted Items included, 10 at a time or up to 1,000 with top; the user is an ID or sign-in name, and bodies come in HTML. search takes words or KQL in double quotes, such as "from:ada"; orderby beside filter must sort by properties that come first in filter, in the same order.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_message
endpoints.description: Returns one message, its body in HTML; select names the fields to return, such as subject,from,toRecipients,body.

endpoints.name: list_folder_messages
endpoints.description: Lists the messages in one mail folder, by its ID or a well-known name such as inbox, sentitems, drafts or archive; filter takes isRead eq false or receivedDateTime ge 2026-01-01.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_mail_folders
endpoints.description: Lists the mail folders at the top of a user’s mailbox with their unread and total counts; hidden folders and subfolders are left out.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_child_folders
endpoints.description: Lists the folders inside one mail folder, by its ID or a well-known name such as inbox, with their unread and total counts; hidden folders are left out.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_attachments
endpoints.description: Lists a message’s attachments with their names, types and sizes; a file’s content comes in contentBytes, base64-encoded.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_calendar_view
endpoints.description: Lists the events in a user’s default calendar between two times, each written as ISO 8601, with recurring events expanded into their occurrences. A time without an offset is read as UTC, and times come back in UTC.

notes.startDateTime: The start date and time of the time range, represented in ISO 8601 format. For example, 2019-11-08T19:00:00-08:00
notes.endDateTime: The end date and time of the time range, represented in ISO 8601 format. For example, 2019-11-08T20:00:00-08:00
notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_events
endpoints.description: Lists the events in a user’s mailbox: single events and the masters of recurring series, not each occurrence, which the calendar view lists. Times come back in UTC and bodies in HTML; filter takes start/dateTime ge '2026-07-01T08:00'.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_event
endpoints.description: Returns one event, its start and end in UTC and its body in HTML.

endpoints.name: list_calendars
endpoints.description: Lists all of a user’s calendars.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_events_in_calendar
endpoints.description: Lists the events in one of a user’s calendars, by the calendar’s ID, between two times written as ISO 8601, with recurring events expanded into their occurrences; times come back in UTC.

notes.startDateTime: The start date and time of the time range, represented in ISO 8601 format. For example, 2019-11-08T19:00:00-08:00
notes.endDateTime: The end date and time of the time range, represented in ISO 8601 format. For example, 2019-11-08T20:00:00-08:00
notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_schedule
endpoints.description: Returns the free/busy availability of users, distribution lists or rooms, by email address, over a period; times come back in UTC. Body: {"schedules": [addresses], "startTime": {"dateTime", "timeZone"}, "endTime": {"dateTime", "timeZone"}}.

endpoints.name: list_contacts
endpoints.description: Lists the contacts in a user’s default Contacts folder; to find one by address, filter with emailAddresses/any(a:a/address eq 'ada@school.edu').

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: send_mail
endpoints.description: Sends an email as the user, by ID or sign-in name, and saves it in Sent Items. Body: {"message": {"subject", "body": {"contentType": "Text", "content"}, "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address"}}]}}.

endpoints.name: reply_to_message
endpoints.description: Replies to a message’s sender, or to its replyTo addresses when it has them, and saves the reply in Sent Items. Body: {"comment"}.

endpoints.name: create_event
endpoints.description: Creates an event in a user’s default calendar; Graph sends an invitation to each attendee, and this can’t be turned off. Body: {"subject", "start": {"dateTime", "timeZone"}, "end": {"dateTime", "timeZone"}, "attendees": [{"emailAddress": {"address"}}]}.

endpoints.name: create_contact
endpoints.description: Adds a contact to a user’s default Contacts folder. Body: {"givenName", "surname", "emailAddresses": [{"address", "name"}], "businessPhones": [numbers]}.
